description:
Field-trial trait values per SNP haplotype of a gene in a phenotyped diversity panel (none: use watkins_haplotype_trait for the Watkins panel):
n, mean and median per haplotype (accession means) across all trials and in each trial, with a Kruskal-Wallis test
across haplotypes of >= min_n accessions, and the protein-changing alleles of each haplotype. trait: name or part
of it ('Days to flowering', 'protein'); no trait lists the panel's traits. trial: part of a trial name to keep.
Exploratory: no correction for population structure or multiple testing, so a difference can reflect ancestry
rather than the gene. group: keep accessions of one group where the panel defines groups (e.g. 'Mesoamerican',
'Andean'); each result gives the phenotyped accessions per haplotype and group.
name: panel_haplotype_trait
